name: tira
description: Deterministic task-tree tracking MVP — executable spec (XState charts), scenario sources, demo

scripts.verify: node charts/verify-node-lifecycle.mjs && node charts/verify-idea-lifecycle.mjs && node charts/verify-tables.mjs
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run scan
scripts.scan: python3 docs/tools/region-scan.py --all charts/node-lifecycle.json charts/idea-lifecycle.json && python3 docs/tools/region-scan.py --all charts/brief-gate.json charts/brief-claim.json charts/brief-outcome.json charts/session.json charts/drop.json charts/refusal.json charts/override.json
